findings.title: SearxNG parse claim is optimistic
findings.detail: GenericJsonSearch._parse only maps the DuckDuckGo Instant Answer shape (AbstractText/AbstractURL/Heading, then RelatedTopics[].Text/.FirstURL). A real SearxNG /search?format=json body is {"results": [{"title", "url", "content"}, ...]} and would parse to [] rather than real hits, while the docs (.env.example, docs/PROVIDERS.md, SKILL.md) and the commit message imply SearxNG works by only changing JARVIS_SEARCH_BASE_URL. Behaviour is still safe (honest empty result, never raises). Tighten the docs or add a SearxNG branch to _parse in a later pass. Does not block Phase 3a: the requirement asks for one real provider (DuckDuckGo) and that is delivered correctly.
